grammar_title: 复杂句综合(定语从句 / 状语从句 / 名词性从句的句法分析与运用)
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 1 Grammar in Use: Complex sentences (review)。三个子技能分关:定语从句关系词、状语从句连词、名词性从句连接词。句子地道、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项),零术语全应用填空。

points.point: 定语从句:关系代词/关系副词(who/whom/whose/which/where/when)
points.overview: 看先行词(人/物/地点/时间/所属)和从句缺什么成分:人作主语 who、人前加介词 whom、表所属 whose、物作主/宾(不与 that 同现时)which、缺地点状语 where、缺时间状语 when。

points.point: 状语从句:让步/条件/结果/时间/原因连词
points.overview: 按逻辑关系选连词:让步 though/although/even though/no matter how;条件 unless/as long as/once;结果 so…that/such…that/so that(目的);时间 as soon as/while/until/before;原因 because/since。靠句意排除其他连词。

points.point: 名词性从句:主语/宾语/表语/同位语从句连接词(that/what/whether/why/how)
points.overview: 从句结构完整(不缺成分)用 that;从句缺主语或宾语用 what;一般疑问(常配 or not)用 whether;表原因用 why、表程度/方式用 how;'the fact/idea + that…' 为同位语从句。

questions.stem: The lecturer ____ overcame his stage fright that night later became famous.
questions.explanation: 先行词 lecturer 指人、从句缺主语 → who;which 指物、where/whose 不能作主语。

questions.stem: Anyone ____ speaks in public for the first time may feel nervous.
questions.explanation: 先行词 anyone 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The teacher ____ spelled words into Helen's hand changed her whole life.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teacher 指人、缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Speakers ____ truly engage the audience usually win warm applause.
questions.explanation: 先行词 speakers 指人、缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The friends ____ sat in the crowd pounded their clubs on the floor.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friends 指人、缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The speaker ____ voice was trembling still managed to finish his talk.
questions.explanation: voice 属于 speaker、表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: Mark Twain, ____ humour delighted everyone, joked about his own age.
questions.explanation: humour 属于 Twain、表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: Helen, ____ world had been silent and dark, longed to understand language.
questions.explanation: world 属于 Helen、表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: We admire writers ____ words can move millions of readers.
questions.explanation: words 属于 writers、表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: The governor's wife, to ____ Twain glanced, led the whole hall in laughter.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom;who 不用于介词后,which 指物。

questions.stem: The audience for ____ he had prepared so hard sat in total silence.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: The teacher from ____ Helen learned everything was Miss Sullivan.
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: The theatre ____ Twain gave his first lecture was dark and almost empty.
questions.explanation: 先行词 theatre 表地点、从句不缺主宾(只缺地点状语)→ where。

questions.stem: Helen reached the well-house ____ the mystery of language was revealed to her.
questions.explanation: 先行词 well-house 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: A stage is a place ____ even brave people may suddenly freeze with fear.
questions.explanation: 先行词 place 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: I still recall the moment ____ my stage fright suddenly left me for good.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: There came a day ____ Helen finally understood that everything has a name.
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Twain remembered the evening ____ he made his first bow as a lecturer.
questions.explanation: 先行词 evening 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: The manuscript ____ lay hidden under the flag was never actually used.
questions.explanation: 先行词 manuscript 指物、从句缺主语且未与 that 同现 → which。

questions.stem: Modern technology, ____ keeps improving fast, now helps the blind communicate.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句指物、缺主语 → which(此处不能用 that)。

questions.stem: ____ he was almost paralysed with fear, Mark Twain still walked onto the stage.
questions.explanation: 前后是让步关系(尽管害怕仍上台)→ Though。

questions.stem: Helen made steady progress ____ she could neither see nor hear.
questions.explanation: '既看不见又听不见'与'取得进步'是让步对比 → although。

questions.stem: You will gradually beat stage fright ____ you keep practising in front of others.
questions.explanation: '只要坚持练习'是条件 → as long as;unless 表否定条件、意思相反。

questions.stem: You cannot really engage your listeners ____ you speak with genuine passion.
questions.explanation: '除非满怀激情,否则吸引不了听众'→ unless(=if…not)。

questions.stem: ____ the audience feels involved, they will go on listening to you.
questions.explanation: '只要听众有参与感'是肯定条件 → As long as。

questions.stem: ____ you feel nervous inside, you should still look confident on stage.
questions.explanation: '即使内心紧张也要显得自信'是让步条件 → Even if。

questions.stem: He bound himself by a hard contract ____ he could not escape the lecture.
questions.explanation: '签合同'的目的是'无法逃避'→ so that(目的状语)。

questions.stem: Speakers move around the stage ____ their presentation feels lively and energetic.
questions.explanation: 走动的目的是让演讲显得有活力 → so that(目的)。

questions.stem: The whole hall was ____ quiet that you could have heard a pin drop.
questions.explanation: 'so + 形容词 + that' 引出结果状语从句 → so;such 接名词、very/too 不接 that 从句。

questions.stem: It was ____ a moving moment that the entire audience sat in silence.
questions.explanation: 'such + a + 形容词 + 名词 + that' 引出结果 → such。

questions.stem: ____ Twain glanced at the governor's wife, the whole hall burst into laughter.
questions.explanation: '一…就…'表时间紧接 → As soon as。

questions.stem: ____ she was drawing water from the well, Helen suddenly grasped the word.
questions.explanation: '在打水的同时'表正在进行的背景时间 → While。

questions.stem: Helen kept confusing the two words ____ the truth finally dawned on her.
questions.explanation: '一直混淆,直到真相显现'→ until(持续到某时间点)。

questions.stem: Several weeks passed ____ Helen realised that every object had its own name.
questions.explanation: '过了几周才…'→ before(…之前/才)。

questions.stem: The audience kept listening closely ____ the speaker sounded truly passionate.
questions.explanation: 听众专注的原因是演讲者充满激情 → because(原因)。

questions.stem: ____ public speaking can be learned, there is really no need to fear it.
questions.explanation: '既然演讲可以学会'是已知原因 → Since。

questions.stem: ____ hard the new word seemed, Helen simply refused to give up.
questions.explanation: '无论这个词多难'是让步 → No matter how。

questions.stem: ____ Twain had spoken in public for years, he never forgot that first agony.
questions.explanation: '尽管已演讲多年'与'难忘初次煎熬'是让步 → Even though。

questions.stem: ____ you win the audience's attention, holding on to it becomes much easier.
questions.explanation: '一旦赢得注意'表条件/时间 → Once;Unless/Although 逻辑不通。

questions.stem: You should still sound natural ____ you are reading from a written script.
questions.explanation: '即使在照稿念'也要自然 → even if(让步)。

questions.stem: ____ Helen learned that morning changed her whole world forever.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 learned 的宾语 → What;that 引导的主语从句须结构完整。

questions.stem: ____ communication sometimes breaks down is something we all experience.
questions.explanation: 从句 'communication breaks down' 结构完整、不缺成分 → That 引导主语从句。

questions.stem: Nobody in the hall could understand ____ the frightened speaker was mumbling.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺 mumbling 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: Mark Twain admitted ____ stage fright felt like a terrible disease to him.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句结构完整、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: He honestly wasn't sure ____ his little joke had really worked or not.
questions.explanation: '…or not' 表示是否、二选一 → whether。

questions.stem: A lack of confidence — that is ____ so many people are afraid of the stage.
questions.explanation: 'that is why…' 表语从句表原因 → why;because 不引导表语从句。

questions.stem: We were all amazed at ____ quickly Helen picked up so many new words.
questions.explanation: 修饰 quickly 表程度 → how(how quickly)。

questions.stem: The fact ____ a deaf-blind girl could learn to read amazed the whole world.
questions.explanation: 'the fact + 完整句子' 为同位语从句 → that。

questions.stem: Real-time translation is exactly ____ travellers need most when they go abroad.
questions.explanation: 表语从句缺 need 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: Lucas keeps reminding us ____ a speech should aim to change people's minds.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句结构完整 → that。

questions.stem: The team kept testing ____ the new app could read the labels aloud or not.
questions.explanation: '…or not' 表是否 → whether。

questions.stem: Helen's early progress depended on ____ her teacher spelled into her palm.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后的宾语从句缺 spelled 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: Listeners noticed ____ calmly the experienced speaker handled the tough question.
questions.explanation: 修饰 calmly 表程度/方式 → how(how calmly)。

questions.stem: ____ the audience stays engaged or not depends largely on the speaker.
questions.explanation: 主语从句配 'or not' 表是否 → Whether(此处不可用 if)。

questions.stem: ____ matters most in a great speech is a genuine connection with people.
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺 matters 的主语 → What。

questions.stem: The nervous speaker promised ____ he would keep his talk short and lively.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句结构完整 → that。

questions.stem: It is really surprising ____ much our gestures add to the spoken words.
questions.explanation: 修饰 much 表程度 → how(how much)。

questions.stem: Write down ____ you want to say clearly before you stand up to speak.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺 say 的宾语 → what。

questions.stem: The idea ____ technology can give a voice to the silent excites many scientists.
questions.explanation: 'the idea + 完整句子' 为同位语从句 → that。

questions.stem: We often wonder ____ machines will ever truly understand us the way people do.
questions.explanation: wonder 后表'是否'、从句结构完整(understand 已带宾语 us)→ whether。
